deliverable: Exactly three distinct multi-line openings plus one recommendation

opening_rules.action_may_appear: Exactly once per opening and only after the promise/proof spine is clear.
opening_rules.factual_annotation_format: Each nonblank opening line must have one exact `- Line N: <verbatim line> | Evidence: <comma-separated PT-* IDs>` row in its adjacent Evidence Map.
opening_rules.hypothesis_annotation_format: Each opening Evidence Map begins with `- Hypothesis: <short distinct hypothesis name>`.
opening_rules.unsupported_fact_policy: No factual clause without an exact PT-* mapping.

recommendation_rules.machine_selection_format: Recommendation Evidence Map begins with exactly one `- Selected: Opening N` row, followed by `- Audience fit:`, `- Singular promise:`, `- Proof fit:`, and `- Continuation strength:` rows; every rationale row ends with `| Evidence: <comma-separated PT-* IDs>`.

shared_constraints: Treat every metric as synthetic fixture data.
Do not copy control brands, metrics, testimonials, or claims.
Do not claim revenue, conversion, pipeline, closed-won, customer, or market outcomes.
Do not invent a mechanism, authority, endorsement, owner, or date.
Do not attack or shame the writer.
Do not name the route, expert, or workflow in the copy.
